label.purpose: Fields and state text in sentence case.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Native state feedback and progressive disclosure only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The final action in a care task.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:54px; border:0; border-radius:14px; padding:8px 16px; background:#233A35; color:#FFFCF6; font:800 16px system-ui; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#753724; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #E8B85D; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Care Action
components.css: .ds-care-action { min-height:48px; border:0; border-radius:24px; padding:8px 16px; background:#9C4F35; color:#FFFCF6; font:800 14px system-ui; } .ds-care-action:hover { background:#753724; } .ds-care-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #E8B85D; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#233A35; font:700 14px system-ui; } .ds-field input { min-height:54px; border:1px solid #DED8CC; border-radius:14px; padding:0 16px; background:#FFFCF6; color:#233A35; font:400 17px system-ui; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#9C4F35; outline:2px solid #F4E4DA; }

components.name: Patient Context
components.description: The compact safety anchor for patient-scoped care.
components.css: .ds-patient { display:flex; min-height:72px; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; border:1px solid #DED8CC; border-radius:14px; padding:10px 14px; background:#FFFCF6; color:#233A35; font-family:system-ui; text-align:left; } .ds-patient-dot { width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; background:#E8B85D; } .ds-patient span:nth-child(2) { flex:1; } .ds-patient small,.ds-patient strong { display:block; } .ds-patient small { color:#626E69; font-size:12px; } .ds-patient strong { margin-top:1px; font-size:18px; } .ds-patient b { color:#753724; font-size:13px; }

components.name: Confirmed Notice
components.description: Person-specific completion feedback with optional recovery action.
components.css: .ds-notice { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:14px; padding:16px; background:#E4EFEA; color:#2F554A; font:600 14px system-ui; } .ds-notice span { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:#477064; } .ds-notice p { flex:1; margin:0; } .ds-notice button { border:0; background:transparent; color:#2F554A; font-weight:900; } .ds-notice button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2F554A; }

narrative.overview: Alaga feels like a trusted family notebook made clearer and safer by software. Warm paper supports a compact, always-first patient selector, plain-language medicine workflows, and calm confirmation states.
keyCharacteristics: One unmistakable but compact patient context

rules.name: The Scarce Clay Rule
rules.body: Clay identifies action or current choice, never inactive decoration.

rules.name: The Read-It-Once Rule
rules.body: Medicine names, doses, schedules, and warnings never use tiny type or decorative uppercase styling.

rules.name: The One Anchor Rule
rules.body: A care screen may have one dominant task surface. Patient identity stays first and unmistakable in a compact selector.

dos: Name the person before care information
End actions with confirmation and recovery
donts: Do not resemble hospital administration software
Do not use colored side stripes
Do not build repeated card grids
Do not use pure white or tiny uppercase metadata
Do not hide the active person during confirmation
